agent_assessment: Retirement is substantively complete but diverges from the plan's §15 Definition of Done in two places. Phase A (orphan rehoming) and Phase B (dependent rewire on adopt-vrooli-emulator-in-deployment-flows) are verified correct. Phase C (archive) is only partially executed: the plan required status="archived", but the backlog data model has no such status value — valid statuses are backlog, researching, ready, queued, in_progress, completed, failed. The agent reasonably chose status="completed" plus an explanatory notes.md, but did NOT invoke the system's dedicated Archive action (which sets an archived_at timestamp and is the correct mechanism for the plan's intent). Consequence: the emulator-platform rollup now shows Completed=3 instead of Completed=2, and the agent itself flagged this inflation in notes.md §Status semantics. A second dependent edge (execute/vrooli-emulator-remote-node-backend in initiative trusted-node-bridge) was missed by the plan but discovered and correctly rewired by the agent during the grep sweep — this is a positive deviation worth surfacing. No code changes were made (correct per §5 out-of-scope) and no active depends_on references to this item remain outside its own files (correct per §15 DoD #6).
notes: PLAN DEFECT: Plan §15 DoD #4 mandates status="archived" but the data model has no such enum value (confirmed via api/internal/backlog/handler.go — there is a separate Archive action that sets archived_at while preserving status). The plan misread the data model.

DEVIATION (defensible): Agent interpreted the intent as status="completed" + explanatory note. The note (notes.md) is transparent and accurate. However, the agent did NOT invoke the Archive endpoint to set archived_at, which would have been the complete faithful execution of the plan's retirement intent.

CONSEQUENCE: Initiative rollup reports Completed=3 (includes this retired item) rather than Completed=2. Agent acknowledged this inflation in notes.md line 11 but did not mitigate it via Archive action.

BONUS: Plan asserted "exactly one" dependent edge (§6). Agent found a second during the Phase D grep sweep (execute/vrooli-emulator-remote-node-backend under initiative trusted-node-bridge) and rewired it. Documented in notes.md §Verification artifacts.
Zero code changes in scenarios/vrooli-emulator/ or scenarios/scenario-to-desktop/ — §5 out-of-scope honored; §13 no-restart note correctly applied.

All stale references to vrooli-emulator-linux-first outside this item's own files are historical/audit (initiative roster, research notes.md referring to the umbrella before decomposition, research review round-001.json). No active depends_on contamination.

improvement_suggestions.description: The plan-authoring skill (or plan validator) should check for the use of non-existent status enum values. A lint pass that cross-references plan DoD against the backlog status enum (backlog, researching, ready, queued, in_progress, completed, failed) would have caught plan §15 DoD #4 = "archived" before execution started. Consider adding to the implementation-plan-authoring validator.

Surface the Archive action (POST /backlog/.../archive → sets archived_at) in swarm-manager-backlog-tools skill documentation. Current skill doc lists 'archived' in the status enum, which misled the plan author. The correct model is status ∈ {completed, failed} AND archived_at optional timestamp. The skill doc should explicitly call out the two-step archival (status flip + archive action) and link to the CLI invocation.

Add a retirement workflow skill or batch-op that performs the full archival sequence atomically: flip status to completed/failed, invoke Archive to set archived_at, rewire depends_on across all dependents (not just ones the plan lists), and emit the audit note. This would prevent the 'Completed count inflation' side-effect and the 'missed second dependent edge' class of plan defects observed here.

Add a backlog consistency check that scans all items for depends_on edges pointing to items with status in {completed, failed} AND archived_at set — those edges should be flagged for rewire. Would have surfaced vrooli-emulator-remote-node-backend automatically instead of relying on the executing agent's grep sweep.

Consider invoking the Archive action on this item to set archived_at, which would (a) bring rollup Completed count back to 2 as the plan expected, and (b) fully honor the plan's retirement intent. This is a one-line CLI call and carries no risk — item is already in a terminal status. (Suggesting here so the human reviewer can decide; the review agent does not mutate.)
